mapper.select: SELECT ef.id, ef.workout_id, ef.exercise_id, ef.feedback_type, ef.created_at FROM exercise_feedbacks ef JOIN workouts w ON w.id = ef.workout_id WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId}::uuid AND ef.exercise_id = #{exerciseId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prescription_adjustments pa WHERE ef.id = pa.first_feedback_id OR ef.id = pa.second_feedback_id) ORDER BY ef.created_at DESC, ef.id DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT p.id, p.workout_id, p.exercise_id, p.sets, p.reps, p.load, p.load_type, p.rpe FROM prescriptions p JOIN workouts w ON w.id = p.workout_id WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId}::uuid AND p.exercise_id = #{exerciseId} AND w.day_number > #{afterDayNumber} AND w.status = 'READY'::workout_status_enum AND w.started_at IS NULL AND w.completed_at IS NULL AND p.removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prescription_adjustments pending WHERE pending.target_prescription_id = p.id AND pending.status = 'PENDING') ORDER BY w.day_number, p.sequence LIMIT 1

SELECT es.to_exercise_id FROM exercise_substitutes es JOIN exercises candidate ON candidate.id = es.to_exercise_id AND candidate.active = TRUE JOIN plans plan ON plan.id = #{planId}::uuid WHERE es.from_exercise_id = #{exerciseId} AND (candidate.equipment = 'body weight' OR plan.profile_snapshot -> 'availableEquipment' @> to_jsonb(candidate.equipment)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prescriptions current_p WHERE current_p.workout_id = #{workoutId}::uuid AND current_p.exercise_id = candidate.id AND current_p.removed_at IS NULL) ORDER BY es.priority, candidate.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription_adjustments (id, plan_id, source_workout_id, source_exercise_id, first_feedback_id, second_feedback_id, target_workout_id, target_prescription_id, original_prescription, suggested_prescription, suggested_exercise_id, reason, reason_en, status, created_at, processed_at) VALUES (#{id}::uuid, #{planId}::uuid, #{sourceWorkoutId}::uuid, #{sourceExerciseId}, #{firstFeedbackId}::uuid, #{secondFeedbackId}::uuid, #{targetWorkoutId}::uuid, #{targetPrescriptionId}::uuid, #{originalPrescription,typeHandler=com.fitness.config.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{suggestedPrescription,typeHandler=com.fitness.config.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{suggestedExerciseId}, #{reason}, #{reasonEn}, #{status}::prescription_adjustment_status_enum, #{createdAt}, #{processedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
